text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to cut 0.22.1 (hotfix) today. Targeting 18:00 PT. Need quick sign-offs: changelog entry, docs note, security backport ok, QA smoke pass, and a rollback plan.

liam: I can own the cut. Will do the branch + tag. Who's on changelog?

maya: s/o to sophia for docs. @sophia can you draft a one-paragraph note and the upgrade note?

sophia: yep, will drop a short blurb in docs PR in ~20m. will reference the CVE note if security confirms.

jordan: @anika can you confirm security backport status? we need a yes/no for the kernel lib fix.

anika: quick update — patch is low-risk, tested in staging. I recommend backporting. I'll add the approval comment on the PR.

devon: QA: I can run a focused smoke suite on staging at 16:00 PT and report. ETA 45m.

maya: great. liam — when you create the cut, please include the commit hash and the changelog fragment. Also add a rollback doc with steps.

liam: plan: create branch hotfix/0.22.1, cherry-pick commit abc1234, run CI, tag v0.22.1. If CI green, push to staging canary. rollback steps will be in the PR description. Example commands I'll run:
```bash
# create hotfix branch
git checkout -b hotfix/0.22.1 upstream/main
git cherry-pick abc1234
git push origin hotfix/0.22.1
# tag
git tag -a v0.22.1 -m "0.22.1 hotfix"
git push origin v0.22.1
```

maya: thanks. devon please ping here when smoke done. anika leave a security sign-off comment. sophia add docs PR link so we can include changelog line.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging-canary -> 16:40 PT. CI status: pending.

devon: smoke run finished — all primary flows pass. one flaky test around auth-refresh, but unrelated to this change.

anika: security: backport approved and signed off in PR #482. added CVE reference. :white_check_mark:

sophia: docs PR is up: https://git.company/docs/pull/890 — contains upgrade note and short description.

liam: CI turned green, tagging now. will start canary rollout in ~5m.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded for canary group A. 10m observation window starts now.

maya: if no regressions, we'll cut prod at 18:00 PT. last call for anything missing?

jordan: quick ask — update the release checklist with the rollback command snippet. otherwise good.

liam: added rollback steps in PR description and release checklist. rollback is: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-server --to-revision=prev` (documented).

maya: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll post a short release note and update the release board after prod cut. :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: Production tag v0.22.1 pushed at 18:02 PT. Post-deploy probes nominal.
